title: 第23章仇人相见第24章仙路漫漫终报当日一脚之仇
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙

;;
夜色寂静。
北寒风盘坐在床榻上，指尖摩挲着腰间的红皮葫芦。
葫芦内，静静躺着九颗筑基废丹。
三颗是今日墨大师炼丹失败所得，其余六颗，则是他之前在废丹院寻到的。
每一颗都色泽黯淡，布满裂痕，灵气全无。在任何人眼中，这九颗筑基丹都是毫无价值的废物。
但在北寒风这里，这是九颗极品筑基丹，是可以让练气境通往筑基境的天梯台阶！
练气九层，距离练气大圆满尚有一段距离。按常理，此刻服用筑基丹，无疑是暴殄天物，甚至可能因无法承受磅礴药力而损伤道基。
但……那是针对寻常筑基丹。
极品筑基丹，毫无丹毒，药力精纯温和，或许……或许能行？
主要北寒风不想等了。
筑基，增寿，掌握自身命运，这渴望压抑太久了。红皮葫芦在手，若还按部就班，这仙修得有何意义？
不过服用极品筑基丹时，其散逸的灵气，绝对会引发不可控的动静。
所以必须先离宗门。
翌日，北寒风寻了个机会，向墨居仁告假。
“大师，弟子入门前，在凡俗尚有一孙。近日心绪不宁，恐其有恙，想告假一段时间，回乡探望，以全血脉之念，求大师成全。”
他声音沙哑，带着老人特有的忧思，神情真切。
墨居仁抬眸看了他一眼，对于踏入仙门还牵挂凡尘亲缘，他虽不以为然，却也理解。沉吟片刻，便点了点头。
“准你数月假期。速去速回，莫要耽误了丹道修行。”
“谢大师。”北寒风躬身退出。

他没有丝毫耽搁，出了丹殿，便径直往山门而去。验过身份玉牌，出了黄枫谷山门。
北寒风没有使用御剑术，而是如同寻常低阶弟子一般，凭借身法在山林中穿行，直至远离宗门数百里，确认无人跟踪后，才在一处荒无人烟的幽深山谷停下。
此谷四面环山，植被茂密，入口隐蔽，正是理想的闭关之地。
他寻了一处背风的石壁，挥动青锋剑，开辟出一个简易洞府，又搬来巨石虚掩洞口，布下几个简单的预警陷阱。
“还需两日，才转化完成。”
北寒风盘坐在洞府中央，摩挲着红皮葫芦。
在等待的两日，北寒风并修炼，在服下一枚辟谷丹后，就开始调动体内灵气打磨着经脉，他要以最好的状态应对两日的未知。
两日时间，过的很快。
第三日清晨，北寒风睁开双眼，眸中精光内敛。
他取出红皮葫芦，深吸了一口气，随即拔开了木塞。
没了木塞的阻挡，九道璀璨夺目的金色光柱猛地自葫芦口冲天而起，将整个山洞映照得如同白昼！同时一股浓郁的药香充斥着整个山洞。
北寒风心中一惊，他没想到极品筑基丹的出世，动静竟如此之大！
幸亏之前有先见之明，告假出了宗门，找一个无人地。如在丹殿内，那引发的后果无法想象。
光柱在持续了十数息开始缓缓收敛。
待光柱完全收敛后，北寒风拿起红皮葫芦，口朝下，轻轻一抖。
一颗圆润无瑕、色泽金黄，表面烙印着四道玄奥道纹的丹药滚落掌心。丹药氤氲之气流转，远非墨大师的中品筑基丹可比。
极品筑基丹！

The night is silent.
Bei Hanfeng sat cross-legged on the bed, stroking the red gourd around his waist with his fingertips.
Inside the gourd, nine foundation-building waste pills lay quietly.
Three of them were obtained from Master Mo's failed alchemy refining today, and the remaining six were found in the Wasted Alchemy Academy before.
Each one is dull in color, full of cracks, and has no spiritual energy. In anyone's eyes, these nine Foundation Establishment Pills are worthless waste.
But here in Beihanfeng, these are nine top-quality foundation-building pills, which are the steps on the ladder that can lead from the Qi-training realm to the foundation-building realm!
At the ninth level of Qi training, there is still a long way to go before the Dzogchen of Qi training. According to common sense, taking the Foundation Building Pill at this moment would undoubtedly be a waste of natural resources, and may even damage the Dao Foundation due to the inability to withstand the majestic power of the medicine.
But...that's for ordinary foundation-building pills.
The best Foundation-Building Pill has no erysipelas and its medicinal power is pure and mild. Maybe...maybe it can work?
Mainly, Beihanfeng doesn’t want to wait any longer.
The desire to build a foundation, increase lifespan, and control one's own destiny has been suppressed for too long. If you still follow the steps step by step with the red-skinned gourd in hand, what's the point of this immortal cultivation?
However, when taking the best foundation-building pill, its dissipated spiritual energy will definitely cause uncontrollable movements.
Therefore, we must leave the sect first.
The next day, Bei Hanfeng found an opportunity to ask for leave from Mo Juren.
"Master, before I became a disciple, I still had a grandson in the mortal world. I have been feeling uneasy recently. I am afraid that he is ill. I want to take a leave of absence for a while and return to my hometown for a visit. With the thoughts of my whole blood, I ask for the master's blessing."
His voice was hoarse, with the unique worry of an old man, and his expression was sincere.
Mo Juren raised his eyes and glanced at him. Although he didn't think so about stepping into the immortal gate and still worrying about mortal relatives, he understood. After pondering for a moment, he nodded.
"You are allowed to take a few months off. Go and come back quickly. Don't delay your alchemy practice."
"Thank you, Master." Bei Hanfeng bowed and exited.
Without any delay, he left the Alchemy Palace and went straight to the mountain gate. After checking the identity jade tag, I left the gate of Huangmaple Valley.
Bei Hanfeng did not use the sword control technique, but instead used his body skills to walk through the mountains and forests like an ordinary low-level disciple. He was hundreds of miles away from the sect and only after confirming that no one was following him, he stopped in a deep and deserted valley.
This valley is surrounded by mountains, dense vegetation, and has a hidden entrance, making it an ideal place for retreat.
He found a stone wall leeward, wielded the Qingfeng Sword, and opened a simple cave. He also moved huge rocks to cover the entrance of the cave and laid out a few simple warning traps.
"It will take another two days for the transformation to be completed."
The cold northern wind sat in the center of the cave, stroking the red-skinned gourd.
During the two days of waiting, Bei Hanfeng continued to practice. After taking a Bigu Pill, he began to mobilize the spiritual energy in his body to polish his meridians. He wanted to be in the best condition to face the unknown of the two days.
Two days passed quickly.
In the early morning of the third day, Bei Hanfeng opened his eyes, the light in his eyes restrained.
He took out the red gourd, took a deep breath, and then pulled out the cork.
Without the obstruction of the cork, nine dazzling golden light pillars suddenly rose from the gourd mouth into the sky, illuminating the entire cave like daylight! At the same time, a strong medicinal fragrance filled the entire cave.
Bei Hanfeng was shocked. He didn't expect that the birth of the best foundation-building pill would make such a big noise!
Fortunately, I had the foresight to take leave and leave the sect to find an uninhabited land. If it were in the Alchemy Palace, the consequences would be unimaginable.
The beam of light began to slowly converge after lasting for ten breaths.
After the light beam completely converged, Bei Hanfeng picked up the red gourd, pointed the mouth downward, and shook it gently.
A round, flawless, golden pill with four mysterious patterns imprinted on its surface rolled down from the palm of my hand. The elixir's dense flow of energy is far beyond the comparison of Master Mo's mid-grade foundation-building elixir.
The ultimate foundation-building pill!
